purpose: Add the domain layer for bulk participant dropout (Withdrawn or Terminated) in APD campaigns with a mandatory single reason, immutable final exit status, and domain event audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Only admins can drop out participants (NOT_ADMIN); empty user selection is rejected (NO_PARTICIPANTS).
All selected participants must belong to the campaign (PARTICIPANT_NOT_IN_CAMPAIGN) and must not have been dropped out previously (ALREADY_DROPPED_OUT).
Dropout type uses ParticipantDropoutType (WITHDRAWN or TERMINATED) and reason is mandatory, non-blank after trim, and at most 255 characters (REASON_REQUIRED, REASON_TOO_LONG).
ParticipantsWereDroppedOut records actor_id, program_code, user_ids (list<int>), dropout_type, and trimmed dropout_reason.
Gateway methods in AcademicProgramDashboardAccessListGateway are intentional stubs for the stacked web PR; translations exist in id and en.
